stanza: Captain Kristofferson!
Buck Sergeant Newbury!
Leatherneck Jones!
Sergeant Cash!
What an Army!
What an Air Force!
What a Marines!
America!
I never served my country
America!

Back in 1965
I got a farm deferment

Frankie came home in '68
And me, I took this job
